testcordplugins/IGP: Downloads an executable OpenPGP library. A reviewed packaged dependency is required.
testcordplugins/pdf-viewer: Downloads executable PDF libraries and a worker. Reviewed packaged dependencies are required.
testcordplugins/PanelLayout: Evaluates imported module source. A packaged or declarative module format is required.
testcordplugins/jstextreplace: Evaluates user supplied JavaScript replacements. A declarative replacement format is required.
testcordplugins/teX: Imports executable KaTeX from a remote CDN. A reviewed packaged dependency is required.
testcordplugins/eval: Executes arbitrary JavaScript and exposes a native evaluation command. Unavailable in browser builds.
testcordplugins/remoteControl: Includes remote JavaScript evaluation commands. A reviewed browser implementation without source execution is required.
testcordplugins/rotatorSuite: Evaluates JavaScript in profile fields. A declarative browser implementation is required.
testcordplugins/DynamicIslande: Requires PanelLayout, whose imported JavaScript modules are unavailable in this browser build.
